podcast.body: Featured on their 1981 album "October," this song includes Bono singing parts in Latin, directly from the Catholic Mass. This impromptu addition occurred because Bono's book of lyrics was stolen prior to the studio recording, prompting him to rely on familiar phrases from his Irish Catholic upbringing. "No 2 with Gloria from 1981. Note how Bono sings part of the song in Latin from the Catholic Mass."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
